1 The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good. (Psalms 53:1 KJV)

David wrote many times in the Psalms about the fool says there is no God. Man tends to think they are their own Gods, and want to believe in evolution as being the way that everything was created, so that they don’t have to acknowledge that just maybe something (God) is smarter than they are. It is very hard for me to understand how a rational person could ever believe that there is no God, and that everything just happened to evolve on its own. How stupid can you get and still live. Just looking at all the creation around us should attest to there being a creator of tremendous intelligence (Romans 1:20).

People, who don’t believe there is a God, are normally corrupt in all their ways, as they have no reason to believe that they will ever have to answer to a creator when they die. After all if they just evolved out of slime, then they can live like animals and not have any fear of being judged after they die. How wonderful it is to not only believe in God, but to know Him (John 17:3), and be His child (Matthew 5:44-45). I can’t imagine how awful it would be to think that this life is all there is to our existence (1 Corinthians 15:19). Knowing God, and knowing that He is love (1 John 4:8), and that He will take us to heaven upon our death, is such a wonderful thing. It makes all the problems in this life of little consequence. I praise God that I don’t have to cease to exist when this life is over. It makes death to be a gateway into something better, and not just the end of life. I truly pity those who don’t believe in God, as they are truly most miserable. Praise God for Jesus!
